title: Before Metaphor on Switch 2
note: Metaphor: ReFantazio comes to Switch 2 on Thursday 12 November. It's a brand-new world, so there's no homework — but if you want to warm up, these are the Atlus RPGs you can play on Switch, most of them from Metaphor's director.

post.sub: No homework needed, it's a new world. But these are the warm-ups, all on Switch.

finale.line: Log these, then start your journey
finale.extra: The whole stack is on Rooms · link in bio
